name: Do I need to sacrifice parking when converting my garage to an ADU?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to sacrifice parking when converting my garage to an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cities within our service area, including Huntington Beach and Mission Viejo, regulations often require homeowners to provide replacement parking on their property when converting a garage into an ADU. This typically means creating a new parking space in the driveway or on a paved area of the lot. The specific requirements can vary by municipality, so it's essential to check local ordinances during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, yes, you must provide replacement parking on your property when converting a garage to an ADU, as required by local city ordinances.
